title: LLM application building blocks
summary: What every LLM system is assembled from: the model and its hosted APIs, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs and tool calling, retrieval over private data (two angles).
intro: This module covers the building blocks that almost every LLM system is assembled from: the model and its hosted APIs (AWS Bedrock and the Claude API among them), the prompt and context around it, typed outputs and tools, and retrieval over private data. It moves from calling a model, to shaping what goes into and comes out of it, to grounding it in data. Retrieval is taught from two angles, the infrastructure for vector search and building with vector databases, and the two lessons sit side by side.

lessons.title: Integrating hosted LLMs: AWS Bedrock, the Claude API and prompt engineering
How LLMs work inside applications: tokens, context windows and model APIs
